jurisdictions.name: European Union target
caveats: Roll-up only; every Member State and included remote region is assessed separately.

jurisdictions.name: Austria
caveats: Nine Länder remain necessary for routes, access, roads, and conditions.

jurisdictions.name: Belgium
caveats: Flanders, Wallonia, and Brussels require separate devolved and multilingual sources.

jurisdictions.name: Bulgaria
caveats: Trail, park, and reuse terms require product-level review.

jurisdictions.name: Croatia
caveats: Island, park, seasonal-access, and municipal overlays are required.

jurisdictions.name: Cyprus
caveats: The whole island is EU territory, but the acquis is suspended where the Republic of Cyprus does not exercise effective control; authority and access claims must identify the controlled area.

jurisdictions.name: Czechia
caveats: Park and regional trail/closure sources remain required.

jurisdictions.name: Denmark
caveats: Faroe Islands and Greenland are not part of the EU target and have explicit exclusion rows.

jurisdictions.name: Estonia
caveats: Recreation and forestry-route products need separate rights and completeness review.

jurisdictions.name: Finland
caveats: Åland is included as an autonomous package; preserve Sámi names and sensitive-site controls.

jurisdictions.name: France
caveats: Six French outermost regions are included as separate packages.

jurisdictions.name: Germany
caveats: Sixteen Länder and local authorities own important route/access data.

jurisdictions.name: Greece
caveats: Island, ferry, archaeological, fire, and local closure overlays are essential.

jurisdictions.name: Hungary
caveats: National spatial/environmental sources and OKIR require exact product and licence review.

jurisdictions.name: Ireland
caveats: A mapped path or natural feature does not establish access across private land.

jurisdictions.name: Italy
caveats: Regions and provinces are critical; CAI and local route content require separate licence review.

jurisdictions.name: Latvia
caveats: Protected-site sensitivity and park conditions require explicit controls.

jurisdictions.name: Lithuania
caveats: Trail authority and update cadence must be verified locally.

jurisdictions.name: Luxembourg
caveats: Exact dataset metadata remains controlling.

jurisdictions.name: Malta
caveats: Coastal access, marine areas, heat, and island transport require dedicated layers.

jurisdictions.name: Netherlands
caveats: Walking networks are decentralised; catalog coverage is not route completeness.

jurisdictions.name: Poland
caveats: National parks, forests, trail organisations, and local closures require separate review.

jurisdictions.name: Portugal
caveats: Azores and Madeira are included as separate remote volcanic/island packages.

jurisdictions.name: Romania
caveats: Mountain trails, parks, counties, and rescue/closure information are fragmented.

jurisdictions.name: Slovakia
caveats: Seasonal closures and park rules are first-class restrictions.

jurisdictions.name: Slovenia
caveats: Alpine routes, rescue information, parks, and local trail authority require layered sources.

jurisdictions.name: Spain
caveats: Seventeen autonomous communities; Canary Islands, Ceuta, and Melilla are explicit included packages.

jurisdictions.name: Sweden
caveats: Preserve Sámi names, land-use context, and sensitive-site controls.

jurisdictions.name: Guadeloupe
caveats: Integral EU outermost region; remote tropical/island, cyclone, volcanic, ferry, and biodiversity rules require a separate package.

jurisdictions.name: French Guiana
caveats: Integral EU outermost region; remote rainforest, river access, protected and Indigenous/local access require a separate package.

jurisdictions.name: Martinique
caveats: Integral EU outermost region; volcanic, cyclone, coastal, and island transport rules require a separate package.

jurisdictions.name: Mayotte
caveats: Integral EU outermost region; marine/coastal access and local safety require a separate package.

jurisdictions.name: Réunion
caveats: Integral EU outermost region; active volcano, cyclone, steep remote trails, and park rules require a separate package.

jurisdictions.name: Saint-Martin (French part)
caveats: Integral EU outermost region; only the French side is included under this jurisdiction.

jurisdictions.name: Azores
caveats: Integral EU outermost region; multi-island ferry/air, volcanic, marine, and rapidly changing weather conditions.

jurisdictions.name: Madeira
caveats: Integral EU outermost region; levada/tunnel geometry, closures, cliff exposure, and island transport require dedicated sources.

jurisdictions.name: Canary Islands
caveats: Integral EU outermost region; multi-island ferry/air, volcano, heat, fire, and park permit rules require a separate package.

jurisdictions.name: Åland
caveats: Included autonomous Finnish region; Swedish is the official language and island transport/local sources must be preserved.

jurisdictions.name: Ceuta
caveats: Included Spanish autonomous city; border, coastal, and local authority conditions require explicit sources.

jurisdictions.name: Melilla
caveats: Included Spanish autonomous city; border, coastal, and local authority conditions require explicit sources.

jurisdictions.name: Faroe Islands
jurisdictions.exclusionReason: Not part of the European Union and not otherwise requested.

jurisdictions.name: Greenland
jurisdictions.exclusionReason: Not part of the European Union and not otherwise requested.

jurisdictions.name: EU-associated Overseas Countries and Territories
jurisdictions.exclusionReason: The OCTs associated with Denmark, France, and the Netherlands are not EU territory; add them only through explicit future scope.

jurisdictions.name: United Kingdom
caveats: Roll-up only; England, Scotland, Wales, and Northern Ireland are assessed separately.

jurisdictions.name: England
caveats: Local highway authorities hold definitive public-rights-of-way records; national compilations can have missing authorities and are not the legal definitive record.

jurisdictions.name: Scotland
caveats: Responsible non-motorised access applies to most land and inland water with statutory and local exceptions; a right of access is not a promoted or safe route.
Access authorities and National Parks maintain Core Paths.
Great Trails, ferries, bus/rail, cable transport, avalanche, mountain weather, stalking/forestry, seasonal roads, bothies, and island access require distinct source lifecycles.
SAIS is link-only until explicit automated reuse terms are approved.

jurisdictions.name: Wales
caveats: DataMapWales licences are per dataset; definitive public-rights-of-way records remain with local highway and National Park authorities.

jurisdictions.name: Northern Ireland
caveats: Ordnance Survey Great Britain products do not cover Northern Ireland; use explicitly open OSNI products or separately licensed data.
DAERA natural-environment viewers expressly do not represent a complete habitat/species record.

jurisdictions.name: Jersey
jurisdictions.exclusionReason: Crown Dependency; not part of the United Kingdom.

jurisdictions.name: Guernsey, Alderney and Sark
jurisdictions.exclusionReason: Crown Dependency; not part of the United Kingdom.

jurisdictions.name: Isle of Man
jurisdictions.exclusionReason: Crown Dependency; not part of the United Kingdom.

jurisdictions.name: United Kingdom Overseas Territories
jurisdictions.exclusionReason: UK Overseas Territories are not part of the United Kingdom and were not separately requested.
members: Pitcairn, Henderson, Ducie and Oeno Islands
Saint Helena, Ascension and Tristan da Cunha
South Georgia and the South Sandwich Islands
Sovereign Base Areas of Akrotiri and Dhekelia

jurisdictions.name: United States target
caveats: Target is the 50 states and District of Columbia; federal extracts must filter explicit territorial exclusions.

jurisdictions.name: Alaska
caveats: Remote access, aviation/ferries, seasonal roads, Alaska Native corporation and Tribal lands, glaciers, bears, avalanches, communications, and rescue require dedicated controls.

jurisdictions.name: Hawaii
caveats: Volcano, surf, flash-flood, heat, island transport, permits, and cultural/sacred/sensitive locations require dedicated controls.

jurisdictions.name: District of Columbia
caveats: Federal/NPS and District/local authority overlap must be retained rather than flattened.

jurisdictions.name: Puerto Rico
jurisdictions.exclusionReason: The requested United States scope is the 50 states plus District of Columbia.

jurisdictions.name: U.S. Virgin Islands
jurisdictions.exclusionReason: The requested United States scope is the 50 states plus District of Columbia.

jurisdictions.name: Guam
jurisdictions.exclusionReason: The requested United States scope is the 50 states plus District of Columbia.

jurisdictions.name: Northern Mariana Islands
jurisdictions.exclusionReason: The requested United States scope is the 50 states plus District of Columbia.

jurisdictions.name: American Samoa
jurisdictions.exclusionReason: The requested United States scope is the 50 states plus District of Columbia.

jurisdictions.name: United States Minor Outlying Islands
jurisdictions.exclusionReason: The requested United States scope is the 50 states plus District of Columbia.

jurisdictions.name: Canada
caveats: All provinces and territories are assessed separately; Indigenous, federal, provincial/territorial, municipal, and private authority must remain distinct.

jurisdictions.name: Newfoundland and Labrador
caveats: Island, Labrador, ferry/air, remote access, and seasonal conditions require distinct evidence.

jurisdictions.name: Québec
caveats: Preserve French official names and Indigenous/local naming authority.

jurisdictions.name: Northwest Territories
caveats: Remote travel, communications, weather, seasonal roads, ferries/air, wildlife, rescue, and Indigenous settlement/land rules require explicit evidence.

jurisdictions.name: Nunavut
caveats: No comprehensive federated territorial recreation portal was established in this assessment; local trail/condition coverage remains unknown.
Remote travel, communications, weather, wildlife, rescue, and Inuit land/community rules require explicit evidence.

jurisdictions.name: Yukon
caveats: Remote travel, communications, weather, seasonal roads, wildlife, rescue, and First Nations land rules require explicit evidence.

jurisdictions.name: Japan
caveats: All 47 JIS prefectures are explicit rows; national source availability does not validate legacy curated points or route completeness.

jurisdictions.name: Hokkaido
caveats: Remote travel, snow, bears, volcanoes, communications, rescue, and Ainu names/sensitivity require dedicated handling.

jurisdictions.name: Fukushima
caveats: Restricted/evacuation areas and official reopening status require current authoritative data.

jurisdictions.name: Tokyo
caveats: Izu and Ogasawara require separate remote-island, ferry, volcanic, marine, and protected-area treatment.

jurisdictions.name: Niigata
caveats: Sado and heavy-snow/seasonal access require dedicated sources.

jurisdictions.name: Yamanashi
caveats: Preserve the official local mountain-grading system without claiming universal equivalence.
Mt Fuji season, reservation/quota, road, and hazard rules require current joint-source handling.

jurisdictions.name: Nagano
caveats: Preserve the official Nagano mountain-grading system without claiming universal equivalence.

jurisdictions.name: Shizuoka
caveats: Mt Fuji season, reservation/quota, road, and hazard rules require current joint-source handling.

jurisdictions.name: Shimane
caveats: Oki Islands require ferry/air, marine, and remote-service handling.

jurisdictions.name: Nagasaki
caveats: Archipelagos, ferries/air, marine weather, and typhoon exposure require dedicated handling.

jurisdictions.name: Kumamoto
caveats: Active volcanic conditions and exclusion zones require current JMA and local authority data.

jurisdictions.name: Kagoshima
caveats: Active volcanoes, Yakushima/Amami, archipelagos, ferries/air, typhoons, and park-specific route grading/rules require dedicated handling.

jurisdictions.name: Okinawa
caveats: Archipelagos, ferries/air, typhoon, heat, coral/marine environments, and sensitive cultural/natural locations require dedicated handling.

jurisdictions.name: Norway
caveats: Mainland, Svalbard, and Jan Mayen are separate packages; mainland access assumptions must not be inherited by Arctic dependencies.

jurisdictions.name: Mainland Norway
caveats: Right to roam applies principally to uncultivated land with exceptions and does not establish a promoted route or override protected-area/local restrictions.

jurisdictions.name: Svalbard
caveats: Separate environment, protected-area, guide/notification, polar-bear, communications, transport, search-and-rescue, and seasonal rules are mandatory.
Do not inherit mainland right-to-roam or route assumptions.

jurisdictions.name: Jan Mayen
caveats: Product access and visitor/travel rules remain unknown until exact official permission and logistics sources are reviewed.

jurisdictions.name: Bouvet Island
jurisdictions.exclusionReason: Remote Norwegian dependency outside the requested practical Norway nature-travel coverage.

jurisdictions.name: Norwegian Antarctic dependencies
jurisdictions.exclusionReason: Antarctic dependencies are outside the requested Norway nature-travel coverage.

jurisdictions.name: Switzerland
caveats: All 26 cantons are explicit child rows; current legacy Swiss POIs remain unverified.
Filter Liechtenstein from cross-border swisstopo products.

jurisdictions.name: Fribourg
caveats: Preserve French and German official/local names.

jurisdictions.name: Graubünden
caveats: Preserve German, Romansh, and Italian names; high-alpine seasonal, avalanche, and cable-transport dependencies are material.

jurisdictions.name: Ticino
caveats: Preserve Italian names; cross-border and high-alpine seasonal conditions are material.

jurisdictions.name: Valais
caveats: Preserve French and German names; glacier, avalanche, seasonal passes, and cable transport are material.

jurisdictions.name: Liechtenstein
jurisdictions.exclusionReason: Separate sovereign state not requested; filter it from Swiss cross-border datasets.
